assessment.guidance: Judge the final work yourself. Packaging checks are not quality scores.

prompt: make a static webapp showing a 3d interactive snow globe showing a scene with a snow-capped peak

settings.thinkingBudgetBasis: CLI/model default; no explicit token budget

artifact.note: Deliverable: index.html, a single self-contained file with a WebGL 3D interactive snow globe featuring a snow-capped mountain peak, pine forest, lodge with glowing window, snow particles with shake physics, refractive glass, and shader night background. Interactions: drag orbit, wheel/pinch zoom, tap/Space shake, and Shake/Auto-spin/Reset buttons. No external dependencies. Harness check passes.
